description:
Discovered while resolving JMAP-1j9k.20 (calendars-client got the cleanup, 4 sites). The same hand-rolled iter chain exists across at least 24 sites in 7 other extension-client crates including the canonical jmap-mail-client:

- jmap-mail-client (CANONICAL): email.rs:46, thread.rs:34, mailbox.rs:39, identity.rs:36, submission.rs:47
- jmap-chat-client: chat.rs:41, custom_emoji.rs:32, message.rs:46, misc.rs:227, misc.rs:302, space.rs:40, space.rs:450, space_invite.rs:28, space_ban.rs:28, contact.rs:30
- jmap-tasks-client: task.rs:28, task_list.rs:40, task_notification.rs:30
- jmap-contacts-client: card.rs:36, addressbook.rs:40
- jmap-filenode-client: filenode.rs:105
- jmap-sharing-client: principal.rs:40, notification.rs:39
- jmap-metadata-client: metadata.rs:70

The pattern:

  args["properties"] = serde_json::Value::Array(
      props.iter().copied().map(serde_json::Value::from).collect(),
  );

The idiomatic two-line replacement:

  args["properties"] = serde_json::to_value(props).expect("&[&str] Serialize is infallible");

Wire output is byte-identical (serde_json::to_value on &[&str] uses the str Serialize impl). The replacement is mechanical.

Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' propagation rule, fix the canonical (jmap-mail-client) first, then propagate to the 6 sibling extension-client crates in the same pass. calendars-client was fixed in JMAP-1j9k.20; this epic catches up everything else.

Children:
.1 jmap-mail-client (canonical, 5 sites)
.2 jmap-chat-client (10 sites)
.3 jmap-tasks-client (3 sites)
.4 jmap-contacts-client (2 sites)
.5 jmap-filenode-client (1 site)
.6 jmap-sharing-client (2 sites)
.7 jmap-metadata-client (1 site)

Acceptance per child:
- All hand-rolled iter chains replaced with serde_json::to_value() one-liner
- cargo test -p <crate> green
- cargo clippy -p <crate> --all-targets -- -D warnings green

Workspace level after all 7 land:
- rg 'iter\(\)\.copied\(\)\.map\(serde_json::Value::from\)\.collect\(\)' returns no matches
- cargo test --workspace green
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings green
title: Workspace sweep: replace hand-rolled props.iter().copied().map(Value::from).collect() with serde_json::to_value(props) across extension-client crates
